description:
Minty helps people find coupons, Cashback, and promotional offers via it's partnered stores. Users can search by a store name to view available coupon codes, Cashback rates, and all available deals with their associated Cashback tracking link. Minty is designed to help users save time and money while shopping online.
Minty does not process payments, sell products, or offer digital goods or subscriptions.
